query:
SELECT ss.sessionId, ss.absent, ss.role,
       ses.problemNumber, ses.sessionNumber, ses.status
FROM session_students ss
JOIN sessions ses ON ses.id = ss.sessionId
WHERE ss.studentId = 300027
ORDER BY ses.problemNumber, ses.sessionNumber;
